results.name: game_engine_waypoint_matches_filter
results.evidence: Reads a 32-byte-stride record from the DAT_006f1888 table (fields for filter player index, team/type short, owner filter) and compares them against param_1/in_EAX; called by the waypoint collector and broadcaster below.
results.summary: Register-argument helper that tests whether one entry of the 32-slot custom-waypoint table applies to a given object/player, honoring -1 wildcard sentinels for player, team-type and owner filters.

results.name: game_engine_waypoint_collect_for_player
results.evidence: Iterates the same 32-entry, 32-byte-stride DAT_006f1888 table calling FUN_004620c0 as a filter and copies matching position/id pairs into caller buffers param_2/param_3 up to param_4, returning the count.
results.summary: For a given player/object filter, walks the custom waypoint table and copies the positions and slot indices of all matching entries into the caller-supplied output arrays.

results.name: game_engine_waypoint_get_position
results.evidence: Copies the three leading dwords (x, y, z) of a DAT_006f1888 record selected by in_CX into the output pointed to by in_EAX; used by interface FUN_004afb90 for HUD nav-marker type 1.
results.summary: Fetches the stored 3D position of a single custom-waypoint slot into a caller-supplied Point3D-sized buffer.

results.name: game_engine_waypoint_add
results.evidence: Writes a new record into the DAT_006f1888 table: copies a position from unaff_EBX, resolves an icon/name index via FUN_004af070 (string table lookup), stores player/type filters from param_2/param_3, marks the slot active, and adds a plus 0.63 height offset plus param_1 to the z coordinate.
results.summary: Registers a new custom HUD waypoint marker at a world position (raised slightly above it) with an icon looked up by name and optional player/type filters.

results.name: game_engine_get_variant_by_name
results.evidence: Long __stricmp chain against every classic/short multiplayer variant name string (classic_slayer, team_slayer, assault, and so on), each branch calling one of the FUN_00463c40..FUN_004652a0/FUN_00467xxx default-builder functions; falls back to the custom-variant/profile cache otherwise. Also matches the cea-pdb naming hint.
results.summary: Looks up a built-in multiplayer game-variant name and either reports whether it exists (param_1 is NULL) or fills the caller buffer with that variant default option values, falling back to the custom/playlist variant cache for unrecognized names.

results.name: game_engine_rasterize_message
results.evidence: Function body is empty (immediate return); name is an existing non-FUN_ hint that the empty body neither confirms nor contradicts.
results.summary: Stub with no body in this retail build; presumably an on-screen game-engine message rasterizer that was compiled out or disabled.

results.name: game_engine_waypoint_broadcast_update
results.evidence: Iterates the DAT_006f1888 waypoint table with FUN_004620c0 as filter and, for matching entries, calls interface functions FUN_004af540/FUN_004af5e0 (HUD nav-marker add/update) guarded by DAT_006f1d20 game-engine type and team-visibility checks.
results.summary: For each active custom waypoint that passes the player/team filter, pushes an add-or-update call into the interface HUD nav-point system.

results.name: game_engine_pack_object_display_flags
results.evidence: Returns (in_EAX and 0xFFFFFF00) unchanged when DAT_0087aa00 bit2 is set, otherwise overwrites the value with bits extracted from the game-option field DAT_006f1cc0 (bit2 into the low bit, bits 10 and up into the upper bytes).
results.summary: Low-confidence: builds a packed flags/color byte for an object from the game engine option bitfield when not in the DAT_0087aa00-bit2 mode, otherwise passes the input through unchanged in its low byte.

results.name: game_engine_get_teams_enabled
results.evidence: Returns DAT_006f1cc4 (0 when engine inactive); the same field is tested as ==0 for free-for-all and ==1 for teams in FUN_00462190, FUN_00462a90 and FUN_004635e0 in this same file.
results.summary: Returns whether the active game engine has team play enabled.

results.name: game_engine_get_misc_option_flag
results.evidence: Returns the inverse of bit 3 of the game-option field DAT_006f1cc0 when the engine is active and the passed object/id is not -1, else defaults to 1.
results.summary: Low-confidence boolean accessor for one bit of the game engine option bitfield, gated on the engine being active and a valid object id.

results.name: game_engine_remap_netgame_equipment
results.evidence: Looks up in_EAX in a scenario placement table at DAT_00746fa0+0x14c/0x150 (0x10-byte entries); when the match index is 0xc or 0xd it substitutes via a PRNG-driven table entry gated by DAT_0087aa00 bits 3/4, otherwise it applies visibility rules keyed by DAT_006f1ce4 (current game-engine/variant type) and DAT_006f1cc0 option bits 3/4, returning -1 to hide the object.
results.summary: Resolves a scenario multiplayer object placement (paired with FUN_00462df0 flag variant) to the actual object/index that should be used for the active game variant, hiding it (-1) when the relevant vehicle/equipment-visibility option is off.

results.name: game_engine_remap_netgame_flag
results.evidence: Uses the same DAT_00746fa0+0x14c/0x150 placement table lookup as FUN_00462c30, then a large switch on DAT_006f1ce4 (game-engine/variant type) remaps the found placement index into a different category, honoring a DAT_006f1d24/DAT_006f1cc0-bit7 override.
results.summary: Resolves a scenario netgame_flag-style placement index into the role/category appropriate for the currently active multiplayer variant type.

results.name: game_engine_remap_start_position
results.evidence: Dereferences a per-slot pointer from the DAT_0087bc14 table (offset 0x14, 0x20-byte stride) to read a leading type field, then dispatches type 2 to FUN_00462df0 and type 3 to FUN_00462c30, doing nothing for type 1.
results.summary: Given a player referenced start/placement object, dispatches to the netgame-flag or netgame-equipment remapping routine based on that placement stored type.

results.name: game_engine_player_is_winner_or_leader
results.evidence: Reads the DAT_0087a480+0x34 player-slot struct fields +0xd5 (elimination flag) and +0xae (score, compared against score-limit global DAT_006f1cd8), falling back to the FFA leader check FUN_00460e40 when neither condition already resolves the outcome.
results.summary: Returns true automatically for an eliminated player or one who has already reached the score limit in a free-for-all game, otherwise returns whether the player is the current FFA leader.

results.name: game_engine_update_player_hint_message
results.evidence: Reads/writes a per-player current-hint-id field (+0x74) in the DAT_0087a480 player table, computing a new id from FUN_00460f30 (score-limit reached) / FUN_00460e40 (is leader) / elapsed-time comparisons against DAT_006f1d6c, then routes it through the game-engine vtable slot +0x6c or the fallback FUN_0045e680(text_id, extra).
results.summary: Determines and dispatches which contextual HUD hint (for example leader, score-limit reached, eliminated) should currently be shown to a player.

results.name: game_engine_get_player_color
results.evidence: Selects between two fixed RGB triples (PTR_DAT_00686b10/PTR_DAT_00686b18) based on a player-slot field (+0x20), or calls FUN_00539c20 (confirmed elsewhere to convert a palette index into a normalized RGB float triple) when DAT_006f1cbc is clear.
results.summary: Returns a 3-float RGB color for a player: either a resolved custom palette color or one of two fixed default colors.

results.name: game_engine_team_has_active_member
results.evidence: Looks up the caller team datum (DAT_008603b0 array indexed by the player team field at +0x34) and scans up to 4 stored member indices at offset +0x2f8, testing a bit (>>3 and 1) of a field on each referenced player via the DAT_0087bc14 indirection table.
results.summary: Checks whether any of up to four registered members of a player team currently satisfy a status bit (plausibly alive/active), returning 1 if found.

results.name: game_engine_reset_team_status_gauge
results.evidence: Looks up the caller object team datum via DAT_008603b0 and, if bit 0x10 of a status byte at +0x204 is set, writes the float 0.5 into +0x37c on that team structure.
results.summary: Resets a per-team floating-point gauge/timer field to 0.5 when a particular team status bit is set.

results.name: game_engine_get_multiplayer_text_list
results.evidence: Calls tag_lookup(ui multiplayer_game_text) and, if found, returns the string-list block via FUN_005578c0; otherwise falls back to the fixed address &DAT_00660c34.
results.summary: Returns the string-list data for the ui\multiplayer_game_text tag (or a built-in fallback list) used for multiplayer HUD/game text strings.

results.name: game_engine_compare_player_score_rank
results.evidence: Uses the game-engine vtable slot +0x4c as a per-object score getter, calls it for the given object then for every other object via data_iterator_next, counting ties/greater-scores to build a result bitmask (win/tie/rank-count flags).
results.summary: Compares one object score against every other tracked object (via the game engine score callback) to compute whether it is winning, tied, and how many objects tie with it.

results.name: game_engine_get_uses_individual_scoring
results.evidence: Returns (DAT_006f1cc0 bit0) OR (DAT_006f1cc4==0), i.e. true when the score-individually option bit is set or the engine is not in team mode; a DAT_006f1cb8==2 and DAT_006f1d06==0 combination forces the team-mode branch instead.
results.summary: Returns whether player scores should be tracked/displayed individually rather than by team, based on the team-mode flag and an option bit.

results.name: game_engine_reset_player_round_state
results.evidence: Calls FUN_00476250(0) (confirmed elsewhere to clear a per-player team-slot field and run cleanup callbacks for a given player) and then the game-engine vtable slot +0x98 if present.
results.summary: Clears a player per-round engine bookkeeping and invokes the active game variant optional reset callback.

results.name: game_engine_object_is_on_winning_team
results.evidence: Compares team scores via the game-engine vtable slot +0x50 (team 0)/+0x50 (team 1), or via FUN_0045c750/FUN_0045c9e0/FUN_0045cee0 when DAT_006f1cbc is clear, then checks the given object team field (+0x20) against the winning side.
results.summary: Determines whether a given object belongs to the currently leading/winning team.

results.name: game_engine_object_wins_round
results.evidence: Finds the matching entry via data_iterator_next on field +0x20, then calls the game-engine vtable slot +0x8c (a per-variant is-winner callback) if present, else falls back to FUN_00463660.
results.summary: Returns whether a given tracked object should be treated as this round winner, deferring to the active variant custom win-check callback when one exists.

results.name: game_engine_scenario_list_find_index
results.evidence: Loops over a DAT_00746f8c+0x37c array (0x94-byte stride, count at +0x378) comparing a field at +0x10 to unaff_DI; the inner loop increments a counter without any other visible side effect in the decompilation.
results.summary: Low-confidence: appears to search a scenario placement list for a matching short identifier, but the decompiled loop body has no observable effect, suggesting lost side effects (for example an element shift/removal) in the Ghidra output.

results.name: game_engine_validate_scenario_lists
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004637c0 twice and then repeats a counting loop against the count field at DAT_00746f8c+900 five times with no other visible effect.
results.summary: Low-confidence: repeatedly walks scenario placement-list counts with no clear side effect in the decompilation; may be a validation/assert routine or a decompiler artifact.

results.name: game_engine_free_custom_variant_cache
results.evidence: Frees each pair of GlobalAlloc allocated name/data pointers in the DAT_00687b0c array (stride 0xA4, count DAT_00687b10) then frees the array itself and resets the cache globals; the same globals are populated by FUN_00463980 and consumed by FUN_00463b20/FUN_00463b90.
results.summary: Releases the dynamically allocated recent/custom game-variant cache and resets its bookkeeping globals to empty.

results.name: game_engine_variant_supported_on_current_map
results.evidence: Extracts the map filename via _strrchr, resolves it to an index with sig__load_multiplayer_maps_demo_sig, checks that index against the map table DAT_00712dcc/DAT_00712dd0 (per-entry enabled flag at +8), and optionally confirms the current variant exists via game_engine_get_variant_by_name.
results.summary: Checks whether the currently loaded map is present/enabled in the multiplayer maps table and, optionally, that the active game variant is a recognized one.

results.name: game_engine_variant_add_to_history
results.evidence: Validates via FUN_00463920, duplicates the variant name/settings (via GlobalAlloc or FUN_00463920/game_engine_get_variant_by_name defaults) and appends a new 0xA4-byte entry to the DAT_00687b0c array, growing it with GlobalAlloc/GlobalReAlloc as needed.
results.summary: Adds a named custom game variant (with either supplied or default option data) to the dynamically-grown recent/custom variant cache.

results.name: game_engine_variant_history_ensure_populated
results.evidence: Frees the cache via FUN_004638b0; if it is still empty and DAT_00714e78 is set, copies a saved 0x26-dword variant block from DAT_00714de0 and re-adds it through FUN_00463980, returning whether the cache is non-empty afterward.
results.summary: Ensures the recent/custom game-variant cache has at least one entry, restoring a previously saved default variant into it if it was empty.

results.name: game_engine_apply_current_custom_variant
results.evidence: Advances the selection cursor DAT_00687b18 through the DAT_00687b0c cache (wrapping at DAT_00687b10), then copies the selected entry name (via _strncpy) and 0x26-dword settings block into the active-variant globals DAT_0087aa40/DAT_0087aa80, deriving a couple of related fields.
results.summary: Cycles to and loads the next entry of the custom game-variant cache into the currently active variant state.

results.evidence: Directly reached from game_engine_get_variant_by_name __stricmp(in_ECX, "classic_slayer") branch, which calls this exact function to fill the caller buffer; body is a fixed sequence of about 0x26 dword/byte writes (score limit, time limit, team-play byte, etc) with no branches.

results.name: game_engine_draw_hud_text_label
results.evidence: Computes a distance-based scale/fade, optionally brightens an RGB color by 0.4 when param_2 is set, fills gradient-box globals (DAT_006e474a/474e/4752/4756) and per-glyph color globals, then calls chimera__draw_16_bit_text.
results.summary: Renders a world-relative HUD text label (with optional highlighted background and distance-based scaling/fade) via the engine 16-bit text rasterizer.

results.name: game_engine_get_setup_wizard_state
results.evidence: Reads a state pointer from DAT_0071c2d4/DAT_0071c2d8 and switches on a field at +0x134 (cases 1-5), further branching on flag bytes at +0x180/+0x184/+400, returning one of a dozen small integer ids (default 8).
results.summary: Maps the current multiplayer game-setup wizard internal state into a small integer id used to drive other UI logic.
